messages:
nora (People Ops): Idea: pilot a 'Recognition Lottery Station' during developer week. Employees drop a short shoutout note in a box to enter a small prize draw (3x $75 e-gift cards). Keeps it low-effort and fun.

ben (People Ops): sounds great. quick Qs: how do we ensure fairness and track winners?

nora (People Ops): plan: stamped slips only at the station; volunteers will mix and draw on-stage. We'll livestream draw and publish winners.

mina (Finance): vendor for cards ok, but remember any single award > $50 is taxable. $75 means we must report. Legal/HR sign-off needed and we need recipient SSN/ID for reporting if required. Consider smaller $45 cards to avoid reporting.

raj (Legal): confirm tax rules. If we keep awards <= $50 we avoid income reporting thresholds. Recommend $45 cards and an alternative small swag basket for one grand prize to keep excitement.

oliver (Facilities): station can be set up by the main lobby 11:30-2:00. I'll reserve a covered box and lockable bin for overnight. Also provide a volunteer table.

nora (People Ops): updated plan: 2 winners x $45 e-cards + 1 swag basket (non-cash). Volunteers: 3 people for setup/oversight. ben can coordinate.

ben (People Ops): volunteers confirmed: @lisa, @omar, and @kevin. I'll draft the short rules card.

raffle-bot: Reminder set: "Recognition Lottery Station draw" on 2026-06-11 13:00 (organizer: nora).

mina (Finance): finance ok for $100 budget on e-cards + $150 for swag. Please tag expense to culture:events. Need vendor quote attached before purchase.

nora (People Ops): awesome. action items: ben to make rules card, oliver to set up station, mina to approve PO, raj to sign off copy. We'll run as a one-day pilot and capture feedback. Thanks team!
